# Dreame MCP Server

Industrial Dreame D20 Pro Plus MCP Server (FastMCP 3.4.x). Talk to DreameHome
cloud via the unified `dreame_tool` portmanteau. Uses the Tasshack reference
protocol for local control and cloud map rendering.

Full documentation: [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt)

## Tools
- `dreame_tool`: Core portmanteau for telemetry, mapping, and navigation.
- `dreame_help`: Industrial documentation helper.
- `dreame_agentic_workflow`: LLM sampling dispatcher for multi-step goals.
- `dreame_shutdown`: Graceful disconnect + server stop.
- `show_dreame_status_app`: Live status as a Prefab card.

## Environment Constants
- `DREAME_USER`: Cloud email.
- `DREAME_PASSWORD`: Cloud password.
- `DREAME_COUNTRY`: Default `eu`.
- `DREAME_DID`: Device id (auto-discovered when single device).
- `DREAME_AUTH_KEY`: Refresh token from previous login.
- `DREAME_REF_PATH`: Path to `tasshack_dreame_vacuum_ref` clone.

## Networking
- Backend: `10894`
- Frontend: `10895`
